description: Heat Market Simulation Tool (HeatSim) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by University Duisburg-Essen. HeatSim (Heat Market Simulation Tool) models the development of a given residential building stock and the corresponding heating system investment choices, which allows insights into future CO2 emissions and the energy demand of residential buildings, as well as an analysis of the impact of various policy instruments. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: discrete choice model, nested logit model, holistic model approach. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
